label: Company tax rate, full rate
notes: Applies to companies that are not base rate entities. The page shows 30% for every year from 2017–18. The 30% rate in Income Tax Rates Act 1986 s 23(2) applies from the 2001-02 year of income (New Business Tax System (Income Tax Rates) Act (No. 1) 1999, No. 167, 1999, Sch 2 items 1 and 12): https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2004A00558/asmade. The tables the ATO's calculators read (TC2TAXRTE) also show 30% from 1 July 2001.
